note: In [L] the $L_{2r}/r$ term is likewise independent of the scale, but because the per-scale parameter is $\min(1,w)r$ (corrected $\delta\mapsto w\delta$ scaling) it still uses monotonicity of $L$ for $w<1$.

have hL : Lg (2 * (w * n)) / (w * n) ≤ Lg (2 * n) / n / w := by
    rw [div_div, mul_comm n w]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Lg_monotoneOn (show 2 * (w * n) ∈ Ici (1340 : ℝ) by
      simp only [mem_Ici]; linarith) (show 2 * n ∈ Ici (1340 : ℝ) by simp only [mem_Ici]; linarith)
      (by nlinarith)) (by positivity)

proof_context.conclusion: For $w\le1$: $L_{2wn}/(wn)\le (L_{2n}/n)/w$ by `Lg_monotoneOn`; the $L$ term carries no dependence on the scale $wy$ (for $w\ge1$ it is unchanged in `gx_scale_le_of_one_le`).
